paragraphs.text: Hello! This is Bam. Thanks for dropping by.
Usually I would introduce myself like: Hi, I’m Bramuda, I am a former journalist turned SEO content writer who happens to write and direct films.
But every time I do that I feel like an answering machine. So unnecessarily fabricated and repetitive.
Personally, I don’t like when someone’s personal site is talking about their glory all the time. It feels like censorship to me. So instead, here's the real me.
I lived the classic failed basketball player trope. Got injured in high school so there goes that dream.
I made 5 short films that took me nowhere, and the money I spent creating them could secure me a house in the midst of this housing crisis (fuck real estate business seriously).
I started writing 2 poetry books when I was 15, and up until now I don't think they'll ever see the light of day.
I physically cannot burp, but I fart so loud it is almost deafening.
I’m a terrifyingly heavy sleeper. My friends hate having me at sleepovers because my endless alarms will definitely wake them, but never me.
I have no savings at all. I make the absolute worst financial decisions, spending so much and making none, leaving me feeling like I am constantly behind in life.
